newsitem.title: ITALY: ENI comments on Enterprise Oil rumour.
newsitem.headline: ENI comments on Enterprise Oil rumour.

text.p: Italy's state controlled energy group ENI, refering to speculation it might takeover Enterprise Oil Plc, said if there was anything to say it should have been said in a recently published privatisation prospectus.
A second tranche of the Italian company is due to be floated at the end of the month.
"If there was anything (to say) it should have had to be in the privatisation prospects published on September 30," a spokeswoman at ENI said, declining any further comment.
Shares Enterprise Oil rose sharply in London for a third day on Thursday with some traders saying there were rumours that the company could be target of a bid.
A spokeswoman for Enterprise said the company was aware of the rumours but had a policy of not commenting on market speculation. Rome newsroom +396 6782501
